abu-bakr-first-caliph.description: A painted interior scene under a timber and palm-thatch roof, with mud-brick walls and palm trunks behind. Sunlight shafts in from above. A bearded man in a brown robe and headwrap kneels and clasps the hand of a white-bearded elder in a cream robe, who sits on a rug. Around them about a dozen men in robes and headwraps sit or stand, some gesturing. No text, frame or gore is visible; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

rashidun-victory-nahavand.description: A mounted battle in a rocky mountain valley. On the left, a bearded man in beige robes and a white turban rides a dark horse and thrusts a long lance, with a round shield on his arm. On the right, a rider in scale armour and a conical helmet on a chestnut horse raises a lance. Behind them more riders with pennants and spears fill a dusty ravine. In the foreground a red and gold patterned cloth lies on the ground, pierced by a spear. No visible text, border or frame.

battle-of-the-camel-caliph-ali.description: A large camel with a covered litter on its back, the litter bristling with arrows, stands in the middle of a dusty battle. Armored men in mail and turbans, some with round shields and swords, press in around it. A fallen figure lies at the bottom edge. Behind them is a hazy skyline of low buildings, minarets and palm trees under a dark smoky sky. The painting fills the frame with no text or border.

great-mosque-damascus-begun.description: Masons and workers on scaffolding inside a stone hall with tall classical columns and arches. A mosaic panel with gold tesserae and green trees runs along an upper wall. A bearded man in a turban and long robe stands in the foreground near a ladder, with torches and a brazier burning, and stone blocks lie on the floor. No visible text, no frame edge.

samarra-founded-by-mutasim.description: A mounted rider in a black and gold robe and white turban sits on a black horse in the foreground, with other riders in tall caps and mail-like armour carrying spears and black banners. Behind them stand tall tan mud-brick walls with wooden scaffolding and small workers, a spiral tower rises on the right, smoke drifts above, and a river runs in the middle distance. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

cordoba-caliphate-proclaimed.description: A painted interior of a hall with red-and-white striped horseshoe arches and stone columns, lit by hanging lanterns and torches. A bearded man in a black robe with gold trim and a turban stands on a raised dais with one arm outstretched, a soft glow behind his head. Facing him, a man in a patterned tunic holds up a scroll. A crowd of turbaned men in robes stands around, some bowing, with a red chair on the dais and a patterned rug on the steps. No visible text, no frame, no blood.

madinat-al-zahra-begun.description: The painting shows a crowd of shirtless workers and oxen hauling a large pale stone column along a dirt slope. Wooden scaffolds and cranes stand at both sides, and a cream stone building with horseshoe arches sits on a terrace behind them, above a valley with a river. The style is dark, oil-painted, with stormy light. I see no visible text, frame or wounds.

buyids-seize-baghdad.description: A painted interior shows a seated man in a black robe and red turban on an ornate gold throne, on a tiled dais. A helmeted, mail-clad guard stands beside him. Through an open arched gate, armoured men with shields, spears and horsemen crowd toward a walled town on a waterfront. No text is visible, and the painting runs edge to edge.

saladin-ends-fatimid-caliphate.description: A painted interior of a large mosque-like hall with a carved wooden pulpit on stairs, where a robed preacher gestures while seated and kneeling men in turbans listen. A tall bearded man in chainmail, a headwrap and a long cloak stands at centre right with a sword, and black banners are held near a doorway at right. Lanterns light the scene, and the walls carry decorative calligraphy bands and arches. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no text, border or frame.

khilafat-movement-india.description: A large crowd of men in white kurtas, white caps and red fezzes fills a plaza in front of a large Mughal-style mosque with domes and tall minarets under a heavy, stormy sky. A man in a dark coat and white trousers stands on a raised wooden platform with one arm raised, addressing the crowd. Several tall cream and gold cloth banners rise above the crowd. No legible text is visible on the banners or elsewhere.
